svg.text: 270 x 270 plate of 18 mm plywood, painted yellow and marked HOLE; a 150 x 40 x 40 softwood handle on top at the middle;
two 180 x 20 x 18 plywood cleats underneath, parallel to the handle, outer faces 180 apart, all four bottom edges bevelled 6 at 45 degrees.
Seated in the 200 mm opening the cleats have 10 mm of play each side and 10 mm each end. Modelled mass 0.94 kg (an estimate): weigh the built cover.
Every size shown is a simulation number. Screw positions are suggested.
PLAN (from above; cleats underneath shown dashed)
+ countersunk screw down through the plate into a cleat, head flush with the plate's top (suggested)
o countersunk screw up through the plate into the handle, head flush with the underside (suggested)
160: between the cleats' centre lines. 180: over the cleats' outer faces.
END VIEW (looking along the handle), seated over the opening
100 mm check bar: must measure 100 mm on the print (print at 100 %, no fit-to-page)
